intro: Turn every meal into an occasion with the Plenteous table. The Sheesham wood top adds rustic warmth, while the strong metal base gives stability, making family dinners and celebrations truly memorable.

features.title: A table that brings everyone together
features.text: The spacious rectangular top comfortably seats six, letting you host family meals, weekend get-togethers, or festive dinners without feeling cramped.

features.title: Solid Sheesham wood with natural charm
features.text: The richly grained Sheesham top adds earthy warmth and a touch of nature indoors, making your dining space feel welcoming and timeless.

features.title: Built strong to host every gathering
features.text: A powder-coated metal understructure supports the heavy wood top, giving you lasting stability and peace of mind during daily use or special occasions.

features.title: Rounded corners for worry-free dining
features.text: Smoothly finished corners make every seating safe and relaxed, especially for homes with children, while adding finesse to the overall design.

features.title: Designed for modern living
features.text: Clean lines and the rustic-meets-industrial look blend beautifully with varied interiors, from urban apartments to traditional homes.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
